render_gop_finding: BATCH-WIDE RENDER BUG (found on clip 6, 2026-08-03): the desilenced spines ship a 250-frame GOP (keyframes only every ~10s) with B-frames. Under Remotion's 8 concurrent OffthreadVideo seeks this fails intermittently with "No frame found at position N" and kills the render mid-way (clip 6 died at frame 565). It is NOT disk pressure and NOT an edit defect. FIX: re-encode the RENDER-ASSETS COPY ONLY to a seek-friendly GOP (-crf 16 -g 25 -keyint_min 25 -bf 0 -sc_threshold 0 -vsync cfr -r 25 -c:a copy), audio stream copied bit-identical, PSNR 51-53 dB. The canonical <slug>-tightened-desilenced.mp4 spine is NEVER touched (this is not a re-cut and not a re-desilence). Relay this to any builder whose render dies the same way.
broll_adjacency_finding: BUILD FINDING (clip 4, 2026-08-03): BrollLayer's ~0.18s adjacency EPS window only suppresses the FADES between two beats; findIndex still returns -1 across the gap, so the base video FLASHES for a few frames. Any plan relying on a sub-EPS gap to "hard cut" between two b-roll beats is wrong: butt the windows exactly (tOut === tIn).
vo_masking_finding: QA WORKING AS DESIGNED (clip 1, 2026-08-03): whisper-verifying the FINAL MIX (not the spine) caught a 0.38-gain whoosh swallowing the payoff word "pop" at 71.36s. Swept offline against Whisper until the word returned (0.20), never lowering the payoff impact itself.
